articles.title: Institutional crypto trading platform LMAX is exploring sale, IPO
articles.snippet: LMAX is working with Morgan Stanley and investment bank KBW to assess its options, which could lead to a sale or a public offering.

articles.title: A $5 billion cluster has formed in bitcoin options. It tells a bullish story
articles.snippet: Bitcoin's $70,000 and $72,000 call strikes on Deribit have accumulated nearly $5 billion in open interest, with calls outnumbering puts by a significant margin.

articles.title: Bitcoin treasury companies sell up, repay debt, pivot to AI as share prices collapse
articles.snippet: Falling share prices, debt obligations and difficult market conditions are forcing former bitcoin accumulators to sell their holdings and restructure operations.

articles.title: BitMEX faces proposed class-action suit for theft, insider trading as crypto exchange shuts down
articles.snippet: The complaint claims BitMEX designed a system to retain customer collateral and alleges an internal desk accessed private user data during server freezes.

articles.title: Ripple’s RLUSD gets two boosts as transfer volume drops 25%
articles.snippet: Ripple launched an institutional minting platform and added RLUSD to Notabene’s compliance network as holder growth rose but monthly transfer volume fell to $10.95 billion.
